Questions

How much is delivery in Ireland?

Standard delivery in Ireland is €5 and free on orders over €60. Orders ship within 1–2 working days and usually arrive 2–3 working days later via An Post.

Do you ship to the UK and Europe?

Yes. Tracked delivery to the UK and EU starts at €9.95 and typically takes 4–7 working days. UK orders may attract customs charges on arrival.
